title: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
titleEn: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: A modernized release of the classic tactical RPG, offering an enhanced presentation, improved usability, and Switch 2 performance/resolution improvements without changing the underlying game content. The story follows Ramza Beoulve as political and personal tensions destabilize Ivalice. The final chapters reveal the larger forces behind the political war and test the player’s strongest tactical builds.

gameplayPillars.title: Grid-based tactical combat
gameplayPillars.description: Turn order, elevation, positioning, terrain, and ability ranges define every encounter.

gameplayPillars.title: Deep job system
gameplayPillars.description: Characters can unlock and combine many jobs, skills, reactions, supports, and movement abilities.

gameplayPillars.title: Political Ivalice story
gameplayPillars.description: The narrative follows war, class conflict, betrayal, religion, and personal loyalty in Ivalice.

gameplayPillars.title: Enhanced presentation
gameplayPillars.description: The Ivalice Chronicles modernizes interface and presentation while preserving the strategic core.

gameplayPillars.title: Switch 2 performance upgrade
gameplayPillars.description: Nintendo states that the Switch 2 version offers improved frame rates and resolution for enhanced visual fidelity.
